name: read_export_record
description: Utility (server-side file I/O, no Revit required): fetch the matching record(s) from a large export JSON file without loading the whole file through the LLM. Scans the primary record array (instances/types/materials/views/bindings) and returns ONLY matches, capped at 10 with a truncated flag. Provide elementId (matched against elementId/id/typeId/viewId), and/or matchKey + matchValue (matched against a top-level field OR a parameters[matchKey].value/.raw, case-insensitive). At least one filter is required. filePath is an absolute path to a file the MCP server process can read.
